aya: Quick heads-up — planning a KEK rewrap next Tue 22:00 PT. Need agreement on RBAC changes + audit hooks before we hit prod.

mike: Are we doing auto-rewrap (rotator) or manual? Auto would re-encrypt ciphertext in-place; manual gives us checkpoints.

jess: I'd vote manual canary first. Too many edge cases w/ multi-cloud KEK ids. :+1:

aya: Agreed on canary. Proposed plan: canary on a single tenant in us-west-2, monitor decrypt error rate and cache misses for 24h, then ramp.

omar: Question: what's expected behaviour if a consumer has an older client that doesn't understand the new envelope header? We need graceful fallback.

lisa: We added envelope header versioning in the spec v2 — clients should ignore unknown headers and try decrypt with KEK reference in ciphertext. If KEK id absent, fallback to legacy path.

mike: To be explicit: we must keep decrypt API compatible for N+1 releases. We'll add a feature-flag in SDK that refuses v2 unless opt-in.

aya: Also need RBAC change: during rewrap, service account 'encryptor' needs both Decrypt and ReEncryptFrom permissions on old KEK and Encrypt on new KEK for AWS/GCP. Azure needs wrapKey/unwrapKey.

security-bot: Reminder: file an IAM change request and add to audit plan. https://internal/iam-requests

jess: For audit logs — include fields: operator, tenant_id, object_key, prev_kek_id, new_kek_id, op_timestamp, result_code. Also log stack traces on failure.

omar: Vulnerability triage: if any explosive error rate occurs (>=0.5% decrypt errors in 5m), abort and revert by toggling traffic to pre-rotate KEK via routing policy.

aya: Revert plan noted. How do we trigger revert? Manual flip in console + automated fallback if autoscaler sees 5xx from decrypt service.

mike: We'll add probe in console: `POST /v1/ops/revert-kek` guarded by RBAC: role=security_admin or infra_oncall only. Hook will set 'use_old_kek': true and start a background abort-check.

jess: Small snippet for audit record format:
```
{ "op":"rewrap", "tenant":"acct-123", "prev_kek":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1111:key/old", "new_kek":"projects/proj/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/new", "status":"success" }
```

lisa: One more Azure quirk — key rotation for Key Vault can produce a new key id but same URI; ensure our canonicalization maps both correctly.

aya: Thanks all. I'll draft runbook and IAM change request. Will ping @oncall when canary starts. :working_on_it:

security-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary window Tue 22:00-02:00 PT. Notifications enabled.

aya: tagging thread closed for now — will reopen with runbook link. :thumbsup:
